extensionDescription.message: Type-ahead search to move emails to a folder, or jump to one.

commandJumpSearchDescription.message: Jump to folder: open folder search

popupPlaceholderMove.description: Search input placeholder in move mode

popupPlaceholderJump.description: Search input placeholder in jump mode

popupNoMatches.description: Shown when a search query has no results

popupError.message: Something went wrong — see the Browser Console for details.

optionsIntro.message: Move and Jump lets you move the selected email to a folder, or jump to a folder, using type-ahead search. Click the toolbar button, or use one of the shortcuts below — rebind them any time from Add-ons Manager → gear icon → Manage Extension Shortcuts.

buttonMove.description: Search window button: move the selected email to the highlighted folder

buttonJump.description: Search window button: jump to the highlighted folder

buttonCancel.description: Search window button: close without doing anything

tooltipLastFolder.description: Toolbar button tooltip after a move/jump
